identity.family: 700 DualCare Water condense 7 kg Washer Dryer

raw_facts.label: Washing capacity guide: Suitable for a single person.
Condenser dryer: Moisture from the drying cycle is condensed and simply drains away.
Auto drying: Set one of the 3 automatic drying levels for quick and easy drying. Either iron, cupboard or extra dry.
Quick wash: A quick wash that allows you to wash 3kgs at 30°C in just 20 minutes.
Aqua control: An internal system which monitors the water level to detect leakage.
ProSense®: Measures the size of the load and automatically adjusts washing time, energy and water consumption.
Wash&Dry 60: Wash in 20 mins or wash & dry a 1kg mixed load in just one hour.
